description: Hold standing at zero desired twist for a bounded interval. Requires an upright robot; not a recovery strategy.

vx.description: Requested forward velocity in m/s; low positive commands may fail to initiate walking.

duration_ms.description: How long to request motion; runtime timeout must include at least 1000 ms extra for stopping.

success_description: Requested interval completed without detected fall, then zero twist and measured settling confirmed. Observed velocities and displacement are evidence; no distance goal is claimed.
